question: National Skill Development Mission was launched by the Prime Minister of India in:
solution:
The correct answer is **__2015__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian PM Shri Narendra Modi on **15 July 2015**, SKILL INDIA MISSION aims to train over 40 crore people in India in different skills by 2022.
 
• The National Skill Development Mission was Approved by the Union Cabinet in the year 2015.
 
• The main aim of the Skill India program is **to provide adequate training in market-relevant skills to over 40 crore youth by 2022**.
 
• It also aims to create opportunities for the development of talent in the country and improve the scope and space for undeveloped sectors.
